gateway_down_live_order_failed.title: Live order did not reach your broker

order_drift_cancelled_rejected.title: Broker fill differs from platform record
order_drift_cancelled_rejected.body: {symbol}: your {side} order was {final} by the broker AFTER submission — the platform recorded it at the requested size ({requested}). Review the position on your broker and correct manually if needed.

order_drift_partial_fill.title: Broker fill differs from platform record
order_drift_partial_fill.body: {symbol}: broker confirmed {filled_txt} of the requested {requested} {side} — the platform ledger recorded the requested size. Review and correct manually.

gateway_down_ibkr_session.title: Your IBKR gateway session is down
gateway_down_ibkr_session.body: {detail} — live and shadow IBKR orders will not fill until you log in to the Client Portal Gateway again.

run_dup_key.title: Run #{run_id} halted: duplicate active run
run_dup_key.body: Another run with the same settings already owns {symbol} ({market}) for this agent, so this one was halted before it could race the same signal.

run_armed_timeout.title: Run #{run_id} timed out while armed
run_armed_timeout.body: Start condition for {symbol} never fired within {hours}h — the run was stopped.

run_stop_eval_failed.title: Run #{run_id} stopped: cannot evaluate stops
run_stop_eval_failed.body: {failures} consecutive stop-evaluation failures ({exc}) — stopping for safety.

run_stop_eval_paused.title: Run #{run_id} paused: stop check failed
run_stop_eval_paused.body: Stop-condition evaluation failed ({exc}); entries are paused until evaluation recovers.

run_goal_restart.title: Run #{run_id} reached its goal — restarted as #{new_run_id}
run_goal_restart.body: {symbol} ({market}) hit {reason}; a new run with the same settings is live.

run_positions_held.title: Run #{run_id} stopped with positions held
run_positions_held.body: Flatten stayed blocked ({why}) past {minutes}min — the position remains open under the SL/TP watcher.

run_infeasible.title: Run #{run_id} paused: cannot fund trades
run_infeasible.body: {count} consecutive cycles with insufficient cash for the configured max bet — paused until funds or settings change.

run_sub_lapsed.title: Run #{run_id} paused: subscription expired
run_sub_lapsed.body: Your plan lapsed, so the run was paused (positions and stops stay managed). Renew to resume.

fleet_watchdog_eval_failed.title: Fleet #{fleet_id}: equity evaluation failing
fleet_watchdog_eval_failed.body: Marked-equity evaluation has failed on stale prices for {fails} consecutive passes — new entries are paused.

fleet_watchdog_stalled.title: Fleet #{fleet_id}: supervision stalled
fleet_watchdog_stalled.body: The fleet supervisor has not run for 3+ ticks — drawdown rails may be dark. Check the worker.

fleet_breaker.title: Fleet #{fleet_id} STOPPED at −{loss_pct}%
fleet_breaker.body: Your Full Auto fleet crossed the −{stop_loss_pct}% stop rail. Every position is being closed. This stop fired at the first check observing the breach; the final loss may exceed the threshold.

fleet_drawdown_warning.title: Fleet #{fleet_id} down {loss_pct}% — paused
fleet_drawdown_warning.body: Your Full Auto fleet has lost {loss_pct}% of its budget. New entries are paused; open positions and their stop-losses remain active. If you resume trading from here, continuing is your responsibility. The fleet stops everything automatically at −{stop_loss_pct}%.

fleet_churn.title: Fleet #{fleet_id}: high replacement churn
fleet_churn.body: {n} member replacements today — the market may be chopping your strategies out. Consider pausing the fleet.

outcome.hold: holding position under the SL/TP watcher.

verification.html:
